situation: My roommate Nadia and I had a blowup on Sunday about the cleaning rota. She said some unfair things too, but I called her lazy and brought up her being out of work. I want to text her and apologize for my part without starting the argument again.
reply: Nadia, I'm sorry I called you lazy on Sunday and brought up you being out of work. That was a low shot and it had nothing to do with the rota. Being out of work is hard enough without me throwing it at you. From now on, when we talk about the flat, I'll keep it to the flat.
note: When you were both out of line, apologise only for your part. Adding 'but you also' cancels it; her share is a separate, later conversation, if at all.

situation: 早上赶时间，把合租室友小林放在冰箱里的一盒酸奶当成我的喝掉了，刚发现。想在微信上跟她说一声，不想搞得很严重。
reply: 小林，早上把你冰箱里那盒酸奶当成我的喝了，不好意思。下班我买两盒给你放回去。
note: 小事就小着道歉：说清是什么、补上就够了，不用长篇自责，否则对方反过来还得安慰你。

situation: I already apologized to my girlfriend for joking about her cooking in front of her parents. She just replied 'whatever, it's fine' and it's clearly not fine. What do I send now?
reply: It doesn't sound fine, and that's fair. Making a joke about your cooking in front of your parents was a cheap laugh at your expense, and I'm sorry. I'm not going to push you to talk about it right now. I'm here when you're ready.
note: Second message after a cold reply: don't defend, don't ask 'are we okay', then actually leave space.

situation: My girlfriend Zoe had her driving test on Thursday, her third attempt. I forgot completely: no good-luck text, and I didn't ask how it went. She passed, and last night she said 'you didn't even ask'.
reply: Zoe, you're right, I didn't even ask. Your third go at the test was a big day and I forgot it completely, no good-luck text and nothing afterwards. You passed something you'd been working towards and I wasn't part of it. From now on, anything big you tell me about goes straight into my calendar. I'd love to take you out on Saturday to celebrate, if you're up for it.
note: Forgetting a partner's big day: agree with their words instead of explaining, then make the change something practical, and the celebration an offer.

situation: I yelled at my 14-year-old son Ethan last night for leaving dishes in the sink. I'd had a bad day at work and it was way out of proportion, he went to his room and slammed the door. I want to text him before school.
reply: Ethan, I'm sorry I yelled at you last night. The dishes were a small thing and I blew it up because I'd had a rough day, which isn't on you. You didn't deserve that. Next time I come home wound up, I'll take a few minutes before I bring up chores. Pizza tonight, just us?
note: Kids need the same four parts as adults: the specific thing, ownership, the impact, and something that repairs. The context goes in one clause, after ownership.

situation: My friend Dev texted me last week that his dog Biscuit, who he'd had for 12 years, had died. I replied 'oh no, RIP' and in the same message asked if he was still coming to my birthday drinks. He didn't come and hasn't messaged since.
reply: Dev, I'm sorry about how I answered when you told me Biscuit had died. I gave you two words and then asked about my birthday drinks, as if twelve years with him were a footnote. You deserved a real reply. I'd love to hear about him whenever you feel like it, and I'm around this week if you want company.
note: Apologising for a careless reply to someone's loss: name exactly what you wrote, and make the repair the attention you didn't give the first time.

situation: 前同事小顾三周前微信问我能不能帮她看一下简历，她想投我们公司的市场岗。我一直忙，看完就忘了回，今天才想起来。岗位10月9号截止。
reply: 小顾，抱歉，你三周前的消息我拖到今天才回，是我的问题。简历你直接发我，我明晚之前看完，把修改意见写给你。岗位10月9号截止，时间还来得及。
note: 回复晚了几周：一句具体的认错，然后直接给答复和一个能兑现的时间，不用长篇解释为什么忘了。

situation: At Sunday dinner at our parents' place, Mei's first time meeting the family, I said my brother Sam's new girlfriend, Mei, was 'another one who won't last'. Mei was in the kitchen and heard it. Sam hasn't answered my texts since. He prefers voice notes, so I'm sending one.
reply: Hey Sam, it's me. I've been thinking about Sunday. What I said about Mei was cruel. And she heard it, on her first night meeting the family. I'm sorry. I'd like to say sorry to her too, in person, if you're both okay with that. You don't need to call back. I just didn't want it sitting there.
note: Real hurt by voice note: short spoken clauses, no 'I was only joking', and the make-good to Mei offered, not imposed.

situation: El sábado me dejé abierto el grifo de la bañera y el agua pasó al piso de abajo. La vecina, Carmen, tiene una mancha grande en el techo del baño. Ya avisé al seguro y el perito puede pasar el jueves 1 de octubre por la mañana. Quiero mandarle un WhatsApp.
reply: Carmen, siento mucho lo del sábado. Me dejé abierto el grifo de la bañera y el agua le ha calado el techo del baño; fue un despiste mío. Sé que ahora tiene una mancha en casa que no ha buscado. Ya he dado parte al seguro, y el perito puede pasar el jueves 1 de octubre por la mañana; si no le va bien, lo cambio al día que usted diga. La pintura corre de mi cuenta.
note: Entre vecinos: el hecho concreto sin excusas, el impacto en su casa y el arreglo ya en marcha, con fecha y dejando que ella elija.

situation: My friend Hana told me in confidence that she and her husband are doing IVF. At drinks on Friday I mentioned it to our friend Chloe, thinking she already knew. She didn't, and Chloe messaged Hana to say she was thinking of her. Hana just texted me 'I can't believe you told Chloe.'
reply: You're right, and I'm so sorry. You told me about the IVF in confidence and I repeated it to Chloe on Friday. That was yours to share, not mine, and I took that choice away from you about something this personal. I won't bring it up with anyone again. I'm here whenever you want to talk, or not.
note: Breaking a confidence: no 'I thought she knew', name what you took from her, and don't ask if you're okay.

situation: 我是小区志愿者群的负责人。上周六（9月26日）的垃圾分类宣传活动，我在群里把集合时间写成了早上8点，其实是9点，十几位邻居白白早到，在门口等了一个小时。想在群里正式道个歉。
reply: 各位邻居，上周六活动的集合时间是我在群里写错了，写成了8点，实际是9点，让十几位邻居一早赶过来，又在门口多等了一个小时，真的对不起。以后每次活动通知，我发之前先对照活动安排核对一遍，活动前一晚再在群里提醒一次时间。下次活动的早饭我来准备。
note: 群里道歉：说清具体错在哪、给大家带来的影响，再给一个以后怎么避免的做法，不用解释是怎么写错的。

situation: My college roommate Jess's dad died three years ago and I never called, didn't go to the funeral, and we just drifted after that. She was the person who got me through college. I want to message her now, even though it's late.
reply: Jess, I've wanted to say this for a long time. When your dad died three years ago, I didn't call and I didn't come to the funeral, and I'm sorry. You got me through college, and when it was your turn to need someone, I disappeared. You don't owe me a reply. I'm here now, and if you ever want to talk about him, or about anything, I'll listen.
note: A years-late apology still needs the specific thing and its impact; don't ask for forgiveness or a reply, just leave the door open.

situation: 妻の美咲に相談せず、共同口座から30万円のロードバイクを買ってしまった。彼女は通帳を見て気づき、「なんで一言もないの」と言った。LINEで謝りたい。
reply: 美咲、相談しないでロードバイクを買ってしまって、ごめん。30万円は二人のお金なのに、一人で決めてしまった。通帳で知ることになって、嫌な気持ちになったと思う。これからは大きな買い物は、必ず先に美咲に相談してから決める。
note: 二人のお金を一人で使ったときは、買った物ではなく「相談しなかったこと」を謝る。返品するかどうかは、そのあと一緒に決めればいい。

situation: 本来想跟闺蜜吐槽婆婆周末来我家一直挑我做饭咸、说孩子穿少了，结果手滑发到了婆婆微信上。两分钟后撤回了，但她回了一句“看到了”。老公说让我自己处理。
reply: 妈，刚才那条是我发给朋友吐槽的，发错到您这儿了，您也看到了，对不起。背后那样说您是我不对，您周末来家里，看到这些心里肯定不好受。以后我对哪件事有想法，就直接跟您商量，不在背后说。这周六我想带孩子过去看看您，您方便吗？
note: 道歉的是背后说和说的方式，不假装那些想法不存在；“以后直接商量”才是真正的改变。

situation: 昨晚快递柜被占满，我在小区门口冲保安刘师傅发了火，说他们什么都不管，其实这根本不归他管。今天下班想当面跟他道个歉。
reply: 刘师傅，昨晚快递柜那事，我冲您发火了，对不起。柜子满了本来就不归您管，是我把气撒在您身上了，还平白挨了我一顿说。以后有事我好好说。
note: 当面道歉用短句：具体的事、承认是迁怒、对方受的委屈，说完就停，不用等对方说“没事”。

situation: At my friend Olu's 30th on Saturday I drank too much and got into a loud argument with his cousin about politics in the middle of the party. Olu had to step in and walk me outside. I want to text him.
reply: Olu, I'm sorry about Saturday. I drank too much and started a shouting match with your cousin in the middle of your 30th, and you spent part of your own party walking me outside. That's on me, not him. I'll message your cousin to apologise too, and at your things from now on I'm keeping it to two drinks. Let me take you out for a belated birthday dinner, whenever suits you.
note: The drink is named as part of what you did, not as the excuse; his lost night is the impact to own.

situation: 昨晚教我爸用手机挂号，他问到第三遍的时候，我不耐烦地说了句“跟你说了多少遍了”。他把手机一放说“不学了”，今天也没怎么理我。我周六会回家。
reply: 爸，昨晚教你用手机挂号，我说“跟你说了多少遍了”，那个语气太冲了，对不起。这个本来就要多问几遍，是我自己没耐心，你听了心里肯定不好受。周六我回去，陪你从头一步一步操作一遍，再把步骤写在纸上给你留着。
note: 对长辈道歉同样点名具体那句话，再给一个实实在在的补救。

situation: On Monday I posted in our building's group chat that someone in the lobby had taken my parcel and should be ashamed. It turns out the courier left it at number 14 next door. My neighbour Priyanka in 4B was the only person in the lobby when it arrived, so it basically pointed at her, and she's been cool with me since. I posted a correction in the group this morning and now want to message her privately.
reply: Priyanka, I'm sorry about my post in the building chat on Monday. The parcel was at number 14 all along, and by saying someone in the lobby had taken it I pointed at you, which was unfair, and I should have checked before posting anything. I can imagine how it felt to have the whole building reading that. I've posted a correction in the group, and next time something goes missing I'll ask the courier first, not the chat.
note: A public wrong needs a public correction; the private message names her specific hurt and asks nothing back.

situation: In our last three team meetings I've talked over my colleague Farah several times, including yesterday when she was halfway through explaining the vendor delays. Nobody said anything, but she went quiet for the rest of the meeting. I want to message her on Slack before Friday's meeting.
reply: Farah, I've realised I keep talking over you in our team meetings, including yesterday when you were halfway through the vendor delays. I'm sorry. It stopped you making your point, and I noticed you went quiet for the rest of the meeting. On Friday I'll wait until you've finished, and I'd genuinely like to hear the rest of the vendor update.
note: A pattern you noticed yourself: name it before they have to raise it, and make the fix something they can watch you do.

situation: 相亲认识的小周，我们聊了一个多月，见过两次面。后来我觉得不太合适，就直接不回她消息了，已经两个月。下周六共同朋友的婚礼上可能会碰到，我想先发个微信跟她道歉，不是想重新开始。
reply: 小周，两个月前我突然不回你消息，对不起。那时候我觉得我们不太合适，却没有说出口，就这么消失了，让你一直不知道是怎么回事，这对你不公平。以后我有这种想法，会直接说出来。这条不用回我。
note: 道歉的是消失的方式，不是那个决定；不求回复，也不借机长篇解释。

situation: My grandmother Rose broke her hip last month and spent two weeks in hospital. I live 20 minutes away and didn't visit once. She's home now and doesn't really use phones, so I'm bringing her a card when I visit on Sunday.
reply: Gran, I'm sorry I didn't come to see you in hospital. You were there two weeks with a broken hip, I live twenty minutes away, and I didn't come once. I should have been there. From now on I'll be round every Sunday afternoon, starting today.
note: A card is read more than once: keep it short and warm, and make the change something she will see happen.

situation: I promised my friend Amara I'd collect her son Jonah, who's 7, from school at 3:15 yesterday because she was stuck at work. I had the wrong day in my calendar and didn't show; the school called her and Jonah waited in the office for 40 minutes until she got there. She texted 'I trusted you with him' and nothing since.
reply: Amara, I'm so sorry. I promised to collect Jonah at 3:15 and I didn't turn up; I had the wrong day in my calendar, and that's on me. You trusted me with your son, and instead he sat in the school office for 40 minutes and you got that call at work. I completely understand if you'd rather not rely on me for pickups for a while. If you ever do again, I'll text you the moment I'm at the gate.
note: When a child was left waiting, own the broken trust, not just the mix-up, and leave the decision about trusting you again with her.

situation: 上周借了好朋友阿杰的相机去拍朋友婚礼，收工时我不小心把镜头摔了，镜片裂了。维修店报价1,800元，我约好了这周六送修。还没跟他说，想今晚在微信上先讲清楚。
reply: 阿杰，跟你说件事：上周借你的相机，收工的时候我不小心把镜头摔了，镜片裂了，对不起。你放心把相机借给我，我却没保管好，这是我的问题。维修店报价1,800元，费用全部我出，这周六我就送修，修好后给你送回去。你要是更想自己找店修，跟我说一声就行，钱照样我来出。
note: 弄坏别人的东西：说清楚发生了什么，赔偿和修理已经安排好，选择权留给对方。

situation: Meu irmão Rafael passou dois meses organizando uma festa surpresa para os 40 anos da esposa dele, a Bia, no sábado 10 de outubro. No almoço de domingo eu falei da festa sem querer na frente dela. Ainda tem um vídeo com mensagens dos amigos que ela não sabe que existe, e eu posso juntar e editar até sexta.
reply: Rafa, desculpa, fui eu que estraguei a surpresa da Bia: falei da festa sem querer no almoço de domingo. Você passou dois meses organizando tudo e eu acabei justamente com a parte que mais importava para você. O vídeo com as mensagens dos amigos ela ainda não sabe que existe, então deixa comigo: eu junto tudo e edito até sexta, para no sábado ainda ter uma surpresa de verdade.
note: O pedido de desculpas reconhece o que o irmão perdeu, não só o deslize, e a reparação devolve a ele uma parte da surpresa.

situation: Samedi, j'ai dit à mon amie Claire que j'étais malade pour ne pas aller au vernissage de son expo photo. En fait j'étais à un dîner chez d'autres amis, et elle l'a vu sur Instagram. L'expo reste ouverte jusqu'au dimanche 18 octobre.
reply: Claire, samedi je t'ai dit que j'étais malade, et ce n'était pas vrai : j'étais à un dîner. Je suis désolée. Ne pas venir à ton vernissage, c'était déjà dommage, mais te mentir, c'est pire, et tu l'as découvert sur Instagram. Je viendrai voir ton expo avant le 18 octobre, et à l'avenir, si je ne peux pas venir, je te le dirai franchement.
note: Quand on s'excuse d'un mensonge, c'est le mensonge qu'on nomme, pas seulement l'absence ; aucune nouvelle excuse pour expliquer la première.

situation: 前天晚上趁老公洗澡，我偷偷翻了他的微信聊天记录，什么都没发现，但他看到我把手机放回去，很生气，说觉得不被信任。他最近常加班到很晚，我心里一直不踏实。想发微信跟他道歉。
reply: 老公，前天晚上趁你洗澡翻你手机，是我不对，对不起。那是你的隐私，我没问你就看了，等于在说我不信任你，换成是我也会很难受。我是因为你最近常加班到很晚，心里不踏实，但这该直接跟你说，不该去翻手机。以后心里不安，我会直接问你，不会再碰你的手机。
note: 道歉的是翻手机这个做法；不安是真实的，可以之后当面聊，但不能拿它当理由，也别在同一条里问“我们没事吧”。

situation: My 4-year-old, Leo, pushed his classmate Maya off the slide at nursery pickup yesterday and she scraped her knee. Leo said sorry on the spot, but I only managed a rushed 'so sorry' to her mum, Grace, before she left. We've talked to Leo at home about pushing, and I'm going to stay closer to him at pickup. I want to text Grace tonight.
reply: Hi Grace, I wanted to say sorry properly for yesterday. Leo pushed Maya off the slide and she hurt her knee, and I'm really sorry, for her and for you, dealing with that at the end of the day. We've talked with him at home about pushing, and I'll be staying closer to him at pickup from now on. I hope Maya's knee is feeling better.
note: Apologising for your child: own it as the parent, say what you've done about it, and don't explain away a 4-year-old's behaviour.

situation: My friend Robin came out as non-binary in June and uses they/them. At book club on Tuesday I called them 'she' twice and then laughed it off with 'old habits'. Robin left early and I want to text them.
reply: Robin, I'm sorry about Tuesday at book club. I called you 'she' twice, and then brushing it off as 'old habits' made it worse. You shouldn't have to sit through that with friends, and I can see why you left early. I'm practising so it comes naturally, and if I slip again I'll correct myself and move on without making it a thing.
note: Misgendering: brief and specific, without so much guilt that they end up comforting you.

situation: 上周我在小红书一个手工皮具博主“阿木”的视频下面留言，说她做的钱包“针脚歪成这样还好意思卖”。今天看到她发动态说这条评论让她难受了好几天。我已经删了评论，想私信跟她道个歉，我们并不认识。
reply: 阿木你好，上周在你钱包视频下面留言说“针脚歪成这样还好意思卖”的人是我，对不起。那句话很刻薄，你花心思做的东西被一个陌生人这样说，难受好几天太正常了。评论我已经删了，以后有看法我会好好说，或者干脆不说。这条不用回我。
note: 给陌生人道歉：先说清你是谁、说了哪句话，不解释动机，也不要求对方回复。

situation: 女儿小雨今年26岁。上周她跟我说，从她初中起我就老在亲戚面前说她胖、让她少吃，她这些年一直很难受。我当时还辩解说是为她好。想给她发微信认真道个歉。
reply: 小雨，那天你说的话我想了好几天。从你初中开始，我老在亲戚面前说你胖、让你少吃，对不起。你跟我说的时候，我还辩解说是为你好，又让你难受了一次。这些年你心里一直不好受，我却没看见。以后我不会再评论你的身材，也不会在亲戚面前说你。
note: 父母向成年子女道歉：连当时的辩解一起认，不用“我那时也不容易”来解释，也不要求她马上原谅。

situation: 上周六和好朋友阿珍去爬山，我没问她就把合照发了朋友圈。那天她跟公司请的是病假，被她领导看到了，周一被叫去谈话。她跟我说“你发之前能不能问一下”，照片我已经删了。
reply: 阿珍，对不起，上周六的合照我没问你就发了朋友圈，害你周一被领导叫去谈话。这是我的问题，发有别人的照片本来就该先问一声。照片我已经删了，以后有你的照片，我都先问过你再发。
note: 只为自己没问就发道歉，不评论她请病假的事。

situation: For six months I've been calling my running club friend Aoife 'Ay-oh-fee', at least twice a week, including when I introduced her to the whole group at the summer relay. Yesterday she corrected me, laughing: it's 'EE-fa', and she said everyone gets it wrong. I want to text her before Saturday's run.
reply: Aoife, I've been saying your name wrong for six months, including when I introduced you to the whole group at the relay, and I'm sorry. You were kind about it, but you shouldn't have to hear your own name mangled twice a week by a friend. It's EE-fa from now on, starting Saturday.
note: Small but repeated: name it once, skip the guilt, and let getting it right be the repair.

situation: Auf meiner Geburtstagsfeier am Samstag habe ich vor etwa zwanzig Leuten den Akzent meiner Freundin Aylin nachgemacht, mitten in einer Geschichte, die sie erzählt hat, und alle haben gelacht. Sie hat danach kaum noch geredet und ist früh gegangen. Wir kennen uns seit dem Studium, und ich will ihr auf WhatsApp schreiben.
reply: Aylin, es tut mir leid, dass ich am Samstag vor allen deinen Akzent nachgemacht habe, mitten in deiner Geschichte. Das war kein Spaß, sondern ging auf deine Kosten, vor zwanzig Leuten, die dann auch noch gelacht haben. Ich kann gut verstehen, dass dir danach die Lust aufs Erzählen vergangen ist. So etwas mache ich nicht wieder. Du musst nicht antworten.
note: Keine Erklärung, dass es nur ein Witz war: genau benennen, was man getan hat, was es für sie bedeutet hat, und ihr Raum lassen.

situation: My daughter Isla, 9, had her first violin solo at the school concert on Wednesday at 6pm. I'd promised I'd be there, but I stayed late for a client call and arrived after she'd played; she said 'you always say you'll come'. I've told my manager I'm leaving at 5 on concert days from now on, and the winter concert is in December. I'm her dad, and I'm writing her a note to put in her lunchbox.
reply: Isla, I'm sorry I missed your violin solo on Wednesday. I promised I'd be there, and I stayed at work for a call instead, so I wasn't there for your very first solo. You're right that I've said I'll come before and then not made it, and that isn't fair on you. I've told work I'm leaving at 5 on concert days, so I'll be there for the winter concert in December. If you'd like to, I'd love to hear your solo at home tonight. Love, Dad
note: With a child, agree with what they said, and make the change something they can see; hearing the solo is an offer, not a fix she owes you.

situation: 钟点工王阿姨在我们家做了三年，每周二、周五来。上周我找不到金手链，当面问她是不是拿了，她很委屈。昨天手链在沙发缝里找到了。想在她下周二来之前先发微信好好道歉。
reply: 王阿姨，手链昨天在沙发缝里找到了。上周我当面问您是不是拿了，冤枉了您，真的对不起。您在我们家做了三年，一直很尽心，我却没先好好找就怀疑您，换成谁都会委屈。以后东西找不到，我会先自己仔细找，不会再随便怀疑人。
note: 冤枉了人：先说真相，再认错和对方受的委屈，不解释当时为什么着急，也不要求她马上说没事。

situation: My friend Priya has been vegetarian her whole life. At my dinner party on Saturday I made a Thai curry and forgot the paste had shrimp in it; she'd eaten a full bowl before I checked the jar and told her. She was gracious in front of everyone but has been quiet since, and I've started reading every label.
reply: Priya, I'm so sorry about Saturday. I served you a curry with shrimp paste in it, and you'd eaten a full bowl before I even checked the jar. You've been vegetarian your whole life and you trusted me to feed you, and I didn't take the care you deserved. You were gracious about it in front of everyone, and you shouldn't have had to be. I read every label now, and if you'll let me cook for you again, I'll have checked everything twice.
note: Name what she ate and the trust it broke rather than how easy the slip was; don't ask if you're okay in the same message.

situation: 上周在家族微信群里，我转了一篇说吃大蒜能防流感的文章，当医生的表哥建忠出来说不靠谱，我当着全家回了一句“就你懂，显摆什么”，群里一下子安静了。我已经在群里补了一句那篇文章不靠谱，现在想私下给他发微信道歉。
reply: 建忠哥，上周在家族群里你出来纠正那篇大蒜防流感的文章，我回了句“就你懂，显摆什么”，对不起。你是好心提醒大家别信错的东西，我却当着全家人的面呛你，让你下不来台。我已经在群里说了那篇文章不靠谱，以后群里有健康方面的东西，我先问问你再转。
note: 当众说错的话，群里的更正和私下的道歉都要有；道歉里只认自己那句话，不争文章本身。
